newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian KomiTEK says 1996 oil output 5.20 mln tonn.
newsitem.headline: Russian KomiTEK says 1996 oil output 5.20 mln tonn.

text.p: Russian oil firm KomiTEK produced 5.20 million tonnes of oil in 1996, including joint venture output, it said in a statement on Monday.
OAO Neftyanaya Kompaniya KomiTEK (KomiTEK) was only formed in 1995, so no comparison for that year was given, but it said it had succeeded in stabilising production.
The company produced 3.26 million tonnes of oil in 1996 not including joint ventures.
KomiTEK owns 51 percent of its main production unit OAO Komineft.
KomiTEK said its Ukhta refinery processed 2.52 million tonnes in 1996, 32 percent higher than in 1995.

The company statement, reporting results of the annual meeting of the board of directors which took place on Friday, said the board approved a plan to attract German investment for reconstruction work on the Ukhta refinery.
Any investment would be backed by guarantees from the government of the Arctic Komi republic, where KomiTEK is based.
KomiTEK said total earnings from crude and product sales reached 2.4 trillion roubles in 1996. Export earnings were $143 million, mainly from crude oil shipments as opposed to products, KomiTEK said.
Profits in 1996 were 318 billion roubles, or 15 billion above planned levels.
The board of directors proposed making a dividend payment of 85 percent on each voting share with the nominal value of 10 roubles.
The annual shareholders' meeting will be held on May 30.
